text: {"lessons":["I should base decisions on future prospects, not on whether a position is above or below my average cost; selling winners early or refusing to sell losers can distort my choices.","A run of monthly declines feels painful, but past price changes do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to losses alone.","Checking and trading frequently can encourage impulsive decisions; I should pause and make deliberate choices rather than trade just to feel in control."]}
